newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa ends higher in modest correction.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa ends higher in modest correction.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures staged a modest correction Wednesday as speculators squared their books after the market's recent slide to seven-month lows.
Traders cited shortcovering by funds and commission houses and bargain hunting by the manufacturing sector.
Most-active March delivery stayed on the plus side throughout the day, ending $9 higher at $1,369 a tonne. Spot December rose the same to $1,327.
But traders said further gains would prove difficult.

The market's failure to fill in crucial chart gaps just above today's highs may in fact trigger a reversal back to the recent lows, they said. March set an intraday peak of $1,375, but would need to clear at the $1,378-1,382 range to attract significant new buying, they said.
A slight narrowing of the London-New York arbitrage, as the British pound pulled back from its recent highs against the U.S. dollar, was seen adding to the overhead resistance, traders said.
The day's turnover reached an estimated 8,956 lots, down from 14,287 lots the previous day.
